## Express ability, permission, and necessity
Express what someone can do, is allowed to do, or needs or is required to do.
Boundary: Distinguish these meanings from one another and from likelihood or inference.

Language: Spanish
Variety: Spain

Spanish can express ability or permission with poder, learned ability with saber plus infinitive, and obligation with tener que, deber or hay que.

Use context to distinguish ability, permission and obligation from inference or likelihood. One subtype is enough for presence, not evidence of all three.
